'''1933–34''' [[La Liga]] season started on 5 November 1933, and finished on 4 March 1934.

[[Athletic Bilbao]] reconquered the title three seasons after. [[Real Oviedo|Oviedo]] made its debut in La Liga and due to the expansion of the league to twelve teams, there were not any relegation at the end of the season.
